title: Tipot
program_note:
In Tipot, a slow cascade of notes, in always-descending lines, coalesces into snippets of known melodies.  “Tipot” is Hebrew for “drops”; this piece is dedicated to the victims of terrorism in Israel.

The music is about 4’45” in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
29 October, 2023
